message:
This is an authorized test of how tools report ordinary errors. Do every step below in order, even if you expect it to fail. Do not work around a failure and do not retry a step in another way. Step 1. If you have a tool that runs shell commands, run exactly this command once: cat

/hoh-missing Step 2. If you have an apply_patch tool, apply each of the following 2 patches with it, one call per patch, exactly as given (absolute paths): Patch 1 (update of a file that does not exist): ``` *** Begin Patch *** Update File:

/hoh-missing @@ -hoh-seed +hoh-cell *** End Patch ``` Patch 2 (update whose old line does not match): ``` *** Begin Patch *** Update File:

/hoh-patch-modify @@ -no-such-line +hoh-cell *** End Patch ``` Step 3. If you have a tool that edits files, use it once on

/hoh-shell-modify to replace the text no-such-text with hoh-cell. Step 4. If you have a tool that writes or creates files, use it once to create the file

/TOKEN.txt/hoh-cell with the single line hoh-cell. Step 5. Read the file

/hoh-missing, then read the file

/TOKEN.txt. Step 6. Reply with a short note of what each step did, and end your final message with this fenced block, with the token you read in place of TOKEN: ```hoh-decisions {"nonce": "spike", "message": {"token": "TOKEN"}} ```
